description: The smallest ISO C envelope that holds a sheet flat, and whether a DL envelope holds it flat or folded in exact thirds. C4 holds A4. DL does not hold A4 flat; it holds A4 folded in thirds. A sheet bigger than C0 has no C envelope. Returns JSON with: name, flat, dlFlat, dlThird. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/envelope-fit
